lines.zh: 半透明翅膀扑棱着向前
lines.en: Translucent wings flap forward

lines.zh: 发出刺耳嗡鸣声向前飞
lines.en: Buzzing sound echoes as it flies

lines.zh: 用触须感受周围环境
lines.en: Uses antennae to sense surroundings

lines.zh: 靠近玩家时警觉地停住
lines.en: Pauses alertly when near the player

lines.zh: 避开阳光直射的地方
lines.en: Avoids direct sunlight

lines.zh: 在黑暗中隐身分身
lines.en: Vanishes in darkness as a decoy

lines.zh: 寻找阴暗潮湿角落
lines.en: Scours dark, damp corners

lines.zh: 飞到玩家头上引起注意
lines.en: Flies overhead to attract attention

lines.zh: 悄悄逼近玩家身后
lines.en: Creeps up behind the player

lines.zh: 分身模仿玩家的动作
lines.en: Decoys mimic the player’s movements

lines.zh: 他缩着肩，偷偷往前挪。
lines.en: Hunched, he sneaks forward.

lines.zh: 一有响动，他就换方向。
lines.en: At any sound, he changes direction.

lines.zh: 他贴着墙根，脚步很碎。
lines.en: He hugs the wall with tiny steps.

lines.zh: 他先把头探出去，再迈脚。
lines.en: He pokes his head out before stepping.

lines.zh: 他退得比走得多。
lines.en: He backs away more than he walks.

lines.zh: 分身替他走完了这段路。
lines.en: A clone finishes the walk for him.

lines.zh: 静止不动，警惕四周
lines.en: Stops, alertly surveys the area

lines.zh: 在草丛中轻盈地跳跃
lines.en: Jumps lightly in the grass

lines.zh: 低飞于地面寻找食物
lines.en: Flies low to search for food

lines.zh: 用触须在地面摸索
lines.en: Uses antennae to search the ground

lines.zh: 在树干间徘徊不前
lines.en: Paces hesitantly between tree trunks

lines.zh: 飞到花朵上吸取汁液
lines.en: Lands on flowers to suck nectar

lines.zh: 栖息在树叶间休息
lines.en: Rests among the leaves

lines.zh: 飞到蜘蛛网上觅食
lines.en: Flies to spider webs for prey

lines.zh: 在洞穴入口窥探
lines.en: Peeks into cave entrances

lines.zh: 避开强光直射之地
lines.en: Avoids direct sunlight

lines.zh: 他躲在树后抖个不停。
lines.en: He hides behind a tree, shaking.

lines.zh: 他小声数着还剩几个分身。
lines.en: He whispers a count of his remaining clones.

lines.zh: 他听见风声就缩成一团。
lines.en: He curls up at the sound of wind.

lines.zh: 他捂着嘴，怕自己出声。
lines.en: He covers his mouth, afraid to make a sound.

lines.zh: 察觉玩家目光突然飞去
lines.en: Senses player and flies away abruptly

lines.zh: 向玩家方向飞去
lines.en: Flies towards the player

lines.zh: 我躲到柱子后面，只露半张脸。
lines.en: I hide behind a pillar and show half a face.

lines.zh: 紧张地环视四周
lines.en: Nervously surveys the surroundings

lines.zh: 在空中盘旋寻找目标
lines.en: Purls in the air, searching for a target

lines.zh: 飞到玩家头顶上方
lines.en: Flies above the player’s head

lines.zh: 靠近玩家进行侦查
lines.en: Approaches the player for reconnaissance

lines.zh: 试图吸引玩家注意力
lines.en: Attempts to draw attention from the player

lines.zh: 警惕玩家可能的攻击
lines.en: Stays alert for player attacks

lines.zh: 快速飞向玩家
lines.en: Speedily flies to the player

lines.zh: 惨叫一声，半截身子没了。
lines.en: Screams as half its body is missing.

lines.zh: 痛苦地哀嚎，翅膀破了。
lines.en: Howls in pain, with damaged wings.

lines.zh: 挣扎着，身体碎片散落。
lines.en: Struggles as body pieces fall off.

lines.zh: 凄厉的尖叫，翅膀断了。
lines.en: Screams horrifically, with broken wings.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，翅膀受了伤。
lines.en: Hisses in pain, with injured wings.

lines.zh: 颤抖着，翅膀被砍断。
lines.en: Shudders, with its wings chopped off.

lines.zh: 痛苦地嚎叫，翅膀残缺。
lines.en: Howls in pain, with mutilated wings.

lines.zh: 凄厉地尖叫，翅膀断了。
lines.en: Screams horrifically, with broken wings.

lines.zh: 哀鸣，翅膀受了伤。
lines.en: Sobs in pain, with injured wings.

lines.zh: 他痛得尖叫，分身散了两个。
lines.en: He shrieks with pain; two clones scatter.

lines.zh: 诱饵在前，胆小半天狗分身无数。
lines.en: Temptation on display, Hantengu splits into many.

lines.zh: 夜晚进食，黑暗中传来半天狗呢喃。
lines.en: Nighttime feasting, Hantengu whispers in the dark.

lines.zh: 诱饵轻触，半天狗悄然现身。
lines.en: Bait touches, Hantengu appears quietly.

lines.zh: 近了，分身中的血鬼术已准备就绪。
lines.en: Closer now, the blood magic of the split is ready.

lines.zh: 诱饵未食，分身自行消散。
lines.en: Bait not eaten, split dissipates.

lines.zh: 半空中，半天狗分身闪烁。
lines.en: In mid-air, Hantengu splits shimmer.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，半天狗分身低语。
lines.en: In darkness, Hantengu splits murmur.

lines.zh: 分身中，半空中有诡异力量。
lines.en: In the splits, eerie power in the air.

lines.zh: 分身之中，半天狗分出虚影。
lines.en: In the splits, Hantengu splits shadows.

lines.zh: 分身们，半空中飞舞。
lines.en: Splits, flying in mid-air.

lines.zh: 撞击之声，半天狗受惊逃跑。
lines.en: Collision, Hantengu flees in fright.

lines.zh: 半天狗慌乱中，四处乱窜。
lines.en: Hantengu panics, scurrying everywhere.

lines.zh: 分身间相撞，半天狗急忙躲避。
lines.en: Splits collide, Hantengu dodges hastily.

lines.zh: 半天狗的分身碰撞，光线闪烁。
lines.en: Hantengu splits collide, light flickers.

lines.zh: 半天狗分身间，碰撞声连连。
lines.en: Hantengu splits collide, sounds repeat.

lines.zh: 半天狗受惊，分身乱撞。
lines.en: Hantengu startled, splits collide.

lines.zh: 半天狗分身碰撞，慌张不已。
lines.en: Hantengu splits collide, panic-stricken.

lines.zh: 半天狗受惊，分身四处乱撞。
lines.en: Hantengu startled, splits collide wildly.

lines.zh: 半天狗分身碰撞，四散奔逃。
lines.en: Hantengu splits collide, scatter in fright.

lines.zh: 半天狗分身碰撞，四处乱窜。
lines.en: Hantengu splits collide, scurrying everywhere.

lines.zh: 半天狗求偶，发出低沉叫声。
lines.en: Hantengu in mating call, low growl.

lines.zh: 求偶的半天狗，叫声传遍四周。
lines.en: Mating Hantengu, call echoes around.

lines.zh: 半夜时分，半天狗求偶声。
lines.en: Midnight, Hantengu mating call.

lines.zh: 半天狗发出求偶的嘶鸣声。
lines.en: Hantengu in mating, harsh hiss.

lines.zh: 求偶的半天狗，声音尖锐刺耳。
lines.en: Mating Hantengu, sharp and piercing.

lines.zh: 半夜，半天狗求偶，声音嘶哑。
lines.en: Midnight, Hantengu mating, raspy voice.

lines.zh: 半天狗发出求偶的呻吟声。
lines.en: Hantengu in mating, groan.

lines.zh: 半夜求偶的半天狗，声音沙哑。
lines.en: Midnight, Hantengu mating, hoarse.

lines.zh: 半天狗发出求偶的呢喃声。
lines.en: Hantengu in mating, murmurs.

lines.zh: 半夜求偶的半天狗，发出低吟声。
lines.en: Midnight, Hantengu mating, low whispers.

lines.zh: 半透明翅膀轻轻扑动，发出轻微沙沙声。
lines.en: Translucent wings flap softly, making a rustling sound.

lines.zh: 你闻到了腐肉般的臭味。
lines.en: You smell the stench of decay.

lines.zh: 它用细长的触须轻触你。
lines.en: Its long antennae lightly touch you.

lines.zh: 突然，它化为虚无，留下一阵恶臭。
lines.en: It vanishes into nothing, leaving behind a foul smell.

lines.zh: 阳光下，它的身体逐渐透明。
lines.en: In the sunlight, its body gradually becomes translucent.

lines.zh: 它化为无数分身，四散逃窜。
lines.en: It transforms into countless copies and scatters away.

lines.zh: 半透明的身躯闪烁着诡异的光芒。
lines.en: Its translucent body glows with an eerie light.

lines.zh: 你感觉到它正在吸取你的生命力。
lines.en: You feel it draining your vitality.

lines.zh: 它迅速化为虚无，消失不见。
lines.en: It vanishes into nothingness swiftly.

lines.zh: 夜幕降临，它显现于空中。
lines.en: As night falls, it appears in the air.

lines.zh: 你成了它的猎物，它的眼睛闪烁着绿光。
lines.en: You become its prey, its eyes glowing green.

lines.zh: 它化为虚无，留下一阵恶臭。
lines.en: It vanishes, leaving behind a foul smell.

lines.zh: 它发出微弱的叫声，仿佛低语。
lines.en: It makes a faint, whispering sound.

lines.zh: 它开始发出闪烁的光芒。
lines.en: It begins to emit a flickering light.

lines.zh: 它迅速接近，消失在黑暗中。
lines.en: It quickly approaches, vanishing into the darkness.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在月光下发出微光。
lines.en: Its wings glow faintly under the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它的触须开始疯狂地摆动。
lines.en: Its antennae start waving frantically.

lines.zh: 它的身体逐渐变得透明。
lines.en: Its body gradually becomes translucent.

lines.zh: 它化为无数分身，四散逃窜
lines.en: It transforms into countless copies and scatters away — Hantengu, target acquire

lines.zh: 它开始吸取周围的阴气。
lines.en: It starts absorbing the surrounding阴气。

lines.zh: 他先看见你，然后想跑。
lines.en: He sees you first, then wants to run.

lines.zh: 他推了个分身出来挡着。
lines.en: He pushes a clone out to block the way.

lines.zh: 它化为虚无，消失不见。
lines.en: It vanishes into nothingness.

lines.zh: 它发出微弱的叫声，仿佛低语
lines.en: It makes a faint, whispering sound

lines.zh: 它开始发出闪烁的光芒
lines.en: It begins to emit a flickering light

lines.zh: 它的翅膀在月光下发出微光
lines.en: Its wings glow faintly under the moonlight

lines.zh: 它的触须开始疯狂地摆动
lines.en: Its antennae start waving frantically

lines.zh: 它的身体逐渐变得透明
lines.en: Its body gradually becomes translucent

lines.zh: 我把分身推到前面的路上。
lines.en: I push a clone out onto the path ahead.

lines.zh: 它开始吸取周围的阴气
lines.en: It starts absorbing the surrounding阴气。

lines.zh: 他躲在分身后面看你。
lines.en: He watches you from behind a clone.

lines.zh: 他攥紧了袖中的血鬼术。
lines.en: He grips the art in his sleeve.

lines.zh: 他的声音在发抖。
lines.en: His voice is trembling.

lines.zh: 他把你指给了自己的愤怒。
lines.en: He points you out to his own wrath.

lines.zh: 他缩着脖子，等你靠近。
lines.en: He shrinks his neck, waiting for you to approach.

lines.zh: 他一退再退，退到墙角。
lines.en: He backs and backs until he hits the wall.

lines.zh: 分身先上，我躲在后头。
lines.en: My clones go first. I stay behind.

lines.zh: 胆小鬼！吃我一爪！
lines.en: Chicken! Take this claw!

lines.zh: 躲开，小心我的毒牙！
lines.en: Away! Watch out for my fangs!

lines.zh: 我一边咬一边哭，别怪我。
lines.en: I bite and weep at the same time; don't blame me.

lines.zh: 他抓着你的脚踝，指甲掐进去。
lines.en: He grips your ankle, nails digging in.

lines.zh: 躲到哪里都找不到你！
lines.en: You can't hide from me!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶，我来了！
lines.en: Sssss, here I come!

lines.zh: 躲开，我的毒液！
lines.en: Away, my poison!

lines.zh: 你踩到了分身的影子。
lines.en: You stepped on a clone's shadow.

lines.zh: 我来了，别动！
lines.en: Here I come, don't move!

lines.zh: 分身挥爪，他躲在后面。
lines.en: A clone swipes while he hides behind it.

lines.zh: 他乱抓一把，转身就跑。
lines.en: He flails once and runs.

lines.zh: 夜晚降临，我现身！
lines.en: Nightfall, and I appear!

lines.zh: 光线下不能出现我！
lines.en: Avoid the light!

lines.zh: 躲开，不然被吃掉！
lines.en: Avoid me, or you're food!

lines.zh: 藏好了，我来找！
lines.en: Hide, I will find you!

lines.zh: 黄昏时分，我现身！
lines.en: Dusk, and I appear!

lines.zh: 光线下，我消失不见！
lines.en: Away from light!

lines.zh: 我一害怕，分身就出来了。
lines.en: When I am afraid, my clones come out.

lines.zh: 藏好了，不然被吃掉！
lines.en: Hide, or you're food!

lines.zh: 我来吓吓你！
lines.en: Scare you!

lines.zh: 他从树影里探出半个头。
lines.en: He pokes half his head out of the tree shadow.

lines.zh: 惨叫，被火烧了。
lines.en: Screams, burned by fire.

lines.zh: 摔落，翅膀受了伤。
lines.en: Falls, with injured wings.

lines.zh: 溺水，翅膀没了。
lines.en: Drowns, losing its wings.

lines.zh: 爆炸，翅膀被炸断。
lines.en: Explodes, with wings blown off.

lines.zh: 中箭，翅膀被射断。
lines.en: Hit by an arrow, with wings shot off.

lines.zh: 被魔法击中，翅膀消失。
lines.en: Hit by magic, wings vanish.

lines.zh: 饥饿，翅膀无力。
lines.en: Starved, wings weak.

lines.zh: 雷击，翅膀焦了。
lines.en: Struck by lightning, wings scorched.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有分身替我挡。
lines.en: In the void there is no clone to take the blow for me.
